title: path agent-mode output envelope
description: Stable agent-mode JSON envelope produced by `rtlscanner path --json`. `path` finds a directional dataflow path from `--from` to `--to` by depth-first search over the same graph fanin/fanout traverse. `data.nodes` is the ordered node walk and `data.edges` the edges between them (nodes[i] --edges[i]--> nodes[i+1]). `--comb` restricts to a purely combinational path (never through a register). `found:false` with empty nodes/edges is a normal result (no such path), not an error.

command.description: Echo of the parsed argparse Namespace minus output flags.

from.description: Resolved start signal name (the driver end of the path).

to.description: Resolved end signal name (the loaded end).

from_scope.description: Scope the start node was resolved in.

to_scope.description: Scope the end node was resolved in.

start.description: Elaborated hierarchical path of the start node (== nodes[0] when found).

end.description: Elaborated hierarchical path of the end node (== nodes[-1] when found).

found.description: True when a path exists. False (an empty nodes/edges) is a normal result — the nodes are not connected in the from->to direction (or, with comb, only through a register) — not an error.

length.description: Hop count (number of edges); 0 for a not-found or single-node (from == to) path.

comb.description: Present and true when --comb was used: the path is purely combinational and never traverses into a register node.

nodes.description: Ordered node path start..end; nodes[i] --edges[i]--> nodes[i+1].

source_bits.description: Bit sub-range of the source that this edge reads ('[5]' / '[7:4]'); absent when the whole signal is read. Bit-level dataflow.

target_bits.description: Bit sub-range of the target that this edge drives; absent when the whole signal is driven. With source_bits, answers 'dout[5] comes from a[2]'.

segments.description: Per-bit permutation map for a copy whose offset varies (a bit reversal 'rev[i]=din[7-i]', a swap 'o={a[3:0],a[7:4]}') — a list of {source_bits, target_bits} sub-copies, e.g. 'din[7] -> rev[0]'. Present only for such a permutation; single-offset and whole-signal edges omit it (source_bits/target_bits then carry the map).

clocked.description: Present and true when the edge is registered (its target is driven by an edge-triggered always_ff / latch / edge-sensitive always) — i.e. a flip-flop boundary; absent for combinational edges (continuous assign, always_comb, port connection).

edges.description: Ordered dataflow edges between the nodes; len == len(nodes)-1. Same edge shape as fanin/fanout (source/target/kind/description/bits/location, plus clocked on a registered edge).

details.description: Machine-readable recovery hints. For SCOPE_NOT_FOUND: valid_prefix, failing_component, close_matches, children. For SIGNAL_NOT_FOUND: close_matches, available.

truncated.description: True when an emitted list was capped by --limit; the count fields still report the true totals.

limit.description: Effective per-list item cap that was applied (0 means unlimited).
